translation.name: Ri C'ac'a Trato ri Xuben ri Dios Quiq'uin ri Vinek

book.name: HEBREOS
book.title: Ri carta ri tz'iban can chique ri kach'alal ri e Hebreos

content: Ri nika' chuvech ri Dios chi nikaben
Vach'alal, yalan utz ri ibanon-pe, chi ivajovan-pe-ivi'. Man c'a tiya' can ri ajovabel ri'.

Y can ninchilabej c'a chuka' chive chi tok ec'o kach'alal ye'apon chi'ivachoch, man tipokonaj ye'icul, xa can jebel c'a quic'ulic tibana'. Roma etaman chi c'o bey banatajinek chi ec'o ángeles ri e apovinek pa tak jay, y ri xec'ulun quichin man xquinabej ta.

Y man que'imestaj ri ec'o pa tak cárcel. Tina' c'a ri k'axo'n pan ivánima, achi'el ta can ja rix ri ix tz'apen. Y chuka' man que'imestaj ri banon chique chi ec'o pa tijoj-pokonal. Roma rix ivetaman achique ri' ri tijoj-pokonal.

Tiya' ruk'ij ri c'ulubic. Roma ri achin ri nic'oje' riq'uin ri rixjayil, man nimacun ta. Que chuka' ri' ri ixok ri nic'oje' riq'uin ri rachijil, man nimacun ta. Jac'a ri achin ri nic'oje' riq'uin jun ixok y xa man rixjayil ta, nimacun. Y que chuka' ri' ri ixok ri nic'oje' riq'uin jun achin y xa man rachijil ta, nimacun. Y ri Dios can xtuk'et c'a tzij pa quivi' ri queri' niquiben.
Man tibe ivánima chirij ri mero, xa can tiquicot ri ivánima riq'uin ri c'o iviq'uin. Roma ri Dios rubin: Can benek-ruvech inc'o iviq'uin y man jun bey xquixinya' ta can. Queri' rubin ri Dios.
Y romari' can riq'uin c'a ronojel ic'u'x yixtiquir nibij:

content.text: Yin ja ri Ajaf ri nito'on vichin.
Romari' man ninxibij ta vi' chiquivech ri vinek ri nicajo' niquiben xabachique itzel chuve.

content: Que'oka' c'a chi'ic'u'x ri uc'uey ivichin, ri can xquiya' chuka' ri ruch'abel ri Dios chive. Tich'obo' ri quic'aslen, roma can xcuker-vi quic'u'x riq'uin ri Dios. Can tibana' c'a ri achique xquiben rije'.
Ri Jesucristo man nujel ta ri'. Can achi'el ri ivir, queri' vacami, y queri' chuka' xtibe-apo. Can man jun bey ri xtujel ta ri'.

Man tiya' k'ij chi ja ri tijonic man e kitzij ta ri ye'uc'uan ivichin. Más ta utz chi rix nicukuba' ic'u'x riq'uin ri tijonic ri nich'on chirij ri rutzil ri Dios, y man riq'uin ta ri tijonic ri nich'on chirij ri yetij. Roma ec'o vinek ri e uc'uan roma ri tijonic ri nich'on chirij ri yetij y xa man jun utz ruc'amon ta pe chique.

Man achi'el ta roj ri can kacukuban kac'u'x riq'uin ri Jesús. Rija' xquen (xcom) koma roj richin xcuyutej ri kamac. Jac'a ri c'a quicukuban na quic'u'x quiq'uin ri chicop ri yequisuj pa ruvi' ri altar ri c'o pa rachoch ri Dios, man xtibanatej ta quiq'uin achi'el kiq'uin roj, roma rije' can man xticuy ta quimac roma ri Jesús. Roma rije' xa c'a riq'uin na ri yequisuj quicukuban-vi quic'u'x.

Ri ley richin ri Moisés nubij c'a, chi ri nimalej sacerdote nuc'uaj c'a ri quiquiq'uel ri chicop y noc-apo chupan ri lugar chire ri rachoch ri Dios ri Más Santo'ilej, y ri quic' ri' nuc'uaj c'a apo roma quimac conojel. Y ri quich'acul ri chicop ye'elesex c'a el c'a chuchi' ri tinamit y yeporox.

Y romari' ri Jesús c'o chi queri' ri xuc'ulvachij. Rija' can xuc'uex-vi c'a chuchi' el ri tinamit, xapon chupan ri rupokonal y xquen (xcom). Can xbiyin-vi ri ruquiq'uel koma roj vinek, richin chi xuch'ajch'ojirisaj ri kánima.
Roma c'a ri' can man tikapokonaj nikac'ovisaj tijoj-pokonal, achi'el ri tijoj-pokonal ri xuc'ovisaj ri Jesús. Y man tikapokonaj nikac'ut chi ja rija' ri katzekelben.

Roma re tijoj-pokonal re' xa can yojcolotej-vi-el chuvech. Xa man richin ta jantape' kilon-ka jun katinamit chuvech re ruvach'ulef. C'a ja ri chila' chicaj c'o-vi ri katinamit, acuchi xkojc'oje-vi jantape', y man jun chic tijoj-pokonal xtikac'ovisaj.

Y roma ja ri Jesús xquen (xcom) koma roj, man yekasuj ta chic chicop chire ri Dios. Ri nikaben vacami ja ri nikaya' ruk'ij. Can jantape' c'a tikaya' ruk'ij y tikak'alajirisaj riq'uin ri kachi' chi ja rija' ri kaniman.
Y man tikamestaj nikaben ri utz y man tikamalij chuka' quito'ic ri c'o nic'atzin chique. Roma jari' ri nika' chuvech ri Dios chi nikaben, que chuvech yekasuj ta chicop chire.

Can tikanimaj c'a quitzij ri kach'alal ri e uc'uey kichin, roma ja rije' ri yechajin ri kánima, y quetaman chi c'o chi nequijacha' cuenta chire ri Dios. Tikanimaj c'a quitzij ri kach'alal ri', richin nikaya' quicoten pa tak cánima. Roma vi xa nikaben chique chi yebison, c'ayef chike roj.
Kach'alal, tibana' c'a orar koma, roma can nikana' chi c'o rayibel pa kánima richin chi ja ta ri utz ri nikaben ronojel bey.
Y jac'a ri oración voma yin ri más ninchilabej chive, richin chi yitiquir yinapon yan ta iviq'uin.
Ri ruq'uisibel tak ch'abel

Ri Dios c'a ri niyo'on uxlanen pa tak kánima, ja rija' chuka' ri xc'ason-pe ri Nimalej Kaj-Yuk' ri Kajaf Jesús. Queri' xuben roma ri Jesús xquen (xcom) y xbiyin ri ruquiq'uel richin xc'achoj ri trato richin jantape' ri xuben ri Dios kiq'uin.

Ri Dios xtuya' ta c'a ronojel rutzil chive, richin chi xquixtiquir ta xtiben ri rurayibel rija'. Y riq'uin ri rusamaj ri Jesucristo ri pa tak ivánima, ri Dios xtuben ta chuka' chive chi rix can nivajo' niben ri rurayibel rija'. Y xtuc'ul ta c'a ruk'ij-ruc'ojlen richin jantape'. Que c'a ri'.
Vach'alal, yin ninc'utuj c'a utzil chive chi can tic'ulu' c'a chi utzil re ch'abel richin pixabanic re xintek-el rubixic chive chupan re vuj re'. Roma xa man nim ta c'a rubanic xinben-el chire.
Yin ninya' rutzijol chive chi ri kach'alal Timoteo libre chic; y vi xtipe chanin, ninc'uaj-el tok xquibe chi'itz'etic.
Tiya' rutzil-quivech conojel ri kach'alal ri e uc'uey ivichin y ri ch'aka' chic lok'olej tak kach'alal. Ri kach'alal aj-Italia niquitek chuka' el rutzil-ivech.
Ri rutzil ri Dios xtic'oje' ta c'a iviq'uin chi'ivonojel. Que ta c'a ri'.
